definitions.explanation: The superlative of fast — the greatest speed among a group. Used for vehicles, athletes, records, and also figuratively for the earliest availability of information or results.

examples.japanese: {最速|さいそく}⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}した→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: He set a new fastest record.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{最速|さいそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スピード→スピード：11048_supiido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}る→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧。
examples.english: This car boasts the fastest speed in the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最速|さいそく}⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}して→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧、⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧⟦メディア→メディア：11165_media⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{競|きそ}い{合|あ}った→競い合う：04656_kisoiau⟧。
examples.english: Various media outlets competed with each other aiming for the fastest reporting of election results.

notes:
USAGE:
{最速|さいそく} functions as a noun or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective. It applies to physical speed as well as figurative speed (e.g., the quickest release of information).

In media and internet contexts, {最速|さいそく} often means "earliest" or "first available" — e.g., {最速|さいそく}⟦レビュー→レビュー：11193_rebyuu⟧ (the first/earliest review).

NOTE: This word is a homophone of ⟦{催促|さいそく}→催促：04159_saisoku⟧ (urging, pressing), which has a completely different meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最速|さいそく}⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: speed record, fastest record
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{最速|さいそく}: world's fastest
- {最速|さいそく}⟦レビュー→レビュー：11193_rebyuu⟧: first/earliest review
- {最速|さいそく}⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧: fastest/earliest reporting
